ask: Should the translator pick the way when tying a word, so each way can list its passages?
problem: Teams may only speak a language, with nothing written. One word can also be said several ways by context. Recordings of the same way must group together, apart from other ways.
found: My last version tied each group to a written word, so oral-only teams could not use it. The record button also sat apart from the clips it belonged to.
changed: Each way is its own card with its clips and its own record button. Add a different way starts a new card. No written word is needed. Passages per way are the next step.
why: Today a tie links a take to a word, not to a way, so passages per way need that choice. Pictures are drawings in app colours, not screenshots. Orange parts are not built.
touches: A new database migration. 15 translations I wrote need a native reader. Phones download the new clips. Play store answers stay the same.
